attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Pennsylvania military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize PA military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "PA Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from PA taxable income
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.pa_subtractions get result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.pa_subtractions xdef
"PA Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "PA Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
